reviews.review: Very good game, with lots of replayability. This game is perfect on a handheld like the PS Vita. I also recommend Risk of Rain Returns, which is a perfect upgrade of this game. I have RoRR on the Switch and its perfect on the go.

new one

After playing a bit more, I came to this review: ROR1 is very cool, I like it, but it doesn't click for me. Why? Idk, I had problems even surviving the first stage on Drizzle. Maybe a skill issue, but after some time, I began to survive more and more and even beat it. Don’t get me wrong, maybe I’m being a crybaby on this, but it was unfun most of the time, standing still and just pressing attack to kill enemies while it takes long because of their big health. Meanwhile, more enemies spawn and swarm around because it’s 2D, and it’s easy to get a big crowd. If there’s no pierce or area damage, it becomes hell quickly. So it takes time to kill all of them while more spawn, and the timer goes up, only making it harder and thus repeating the same thing.
I really wish I got into this game as much as I did with risk of rain 2, but it doesn't sit right for me, and I do love 2d games but risk of rain 1 doesn't get me, the moving around is clunky and slow, the 2d makes it a pain to deal with enemies, and the bosses? kind of the same problem with enemies, it isn't like dynamic to fight them here. magma worm is a demon, I hate it to the roots, but it is fun how a threat it is.

well to be fair with you, get it, I got it because it was cheap, and I liked risk of rain 2.
but Idk maybe the game clicks for you, I'm so sad it didn't for me, as I wanted to play it for the lore and well, the before ror2, maybe I will try it again. also I almost didn't recommend it lol, got me very mad at it, but then it was a little fun so ig it isn't that bad.
